name: GlassFractalLayout
material_impl: Root is OptimizedGlass with hard-coded glassConfig blur 15/opacity .9/saturation 1.1 (L404-410). Each node is a bespoke Tailwind-ish div 'glass-surface rounded-lg border border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10' (L449-459) — a nested backdrop-filter per node, untokenized white alpha borders. Connection lines are 1px border-l divs rotated in CSS (L470-497).
motion: framer-motion variants, but transitions use react-spring keys 'tension'/'friction' (L364-366, 373-374) which framer-motion ignores, so springs fall back to defaults. Growth animation is a manual rAF setState loop for 2s (L138-162) re-rendering the whole tree each frame. Reduced motion IS wired via useMotionPreference: growth skipped (L137-155), delay zeroed (L367).
a11y: role='application' with aria-label (L412-413) but nodes are clickable motion.divs with onClick/onMouseEnter only — no tabIndex, no role, no keyboard (L429-447). Certification DOM inspection: focusableElementCount=3 at both viewports, i.e. only the Storybook skip links — zero focusable component content. role=application without keyboard handling is an anti-pattern. Hover sounds on by default (soundEnabled=true, L92, L337-339).
api: forwardRef yes; className/style passthrough (string concat, not cn). Non-standard props: compact/contained/maxHeight/height overlap. Unused imports cn, ContrastGuard, TextWithContrast (L11, L16-19). handleWheel calls preventDefault in a React onWheel (passive) handler — it will not prevent page scroll and logs an intervention warning (L344-355).
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. useGlassSound imports a global WebAudio sound singleton.
fake_complexity: fractalType 'mandelbrot' computes an unused constant c and just lays nodes on a linear diagonal (L244-252); 'julia' and 'custom' are not implemented and fall to a default row layout (L254-260); 'sierpinski' is three points on a circle. It is a radial tree positioner with fractal branding.
justification: A novelty demo with no real product use case: the 'fractal' types are mislabeled positioning presets (mandelbrot/julia are fake), nodes are not keyboard reachable, springs are misconfigured for framer-motion, and the visible chrome is a debug HUD ('Type/Depth/Nodes/Zoom' badges L512-529). 24 stories on a component nobody should ship inflate surface area. Remove from 5.0; if a tree visualization is wanted it belongs in a data-viz package built on a real layout algorithm.

name: GlassGoldenRatioGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root with hard-coded glassConfig (L405-411); every cell is a bespoke 'glass-surface rounded-lg border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10' div (L500-510). Hard-coded gold spiral stroke rgba(255,215,0,0.3) (L434) and rgba(255,255,255,.24) legend (L590).
motion: framer-motion scale-in variants with invalid tension/friction keys (L347-368). Reduced motion only zeroes the stagger delay (L351); scale 0->1 still animates for reduced-motion users.
a11y: role='grid' > role='row' > role='gridcell' (L412, L496, L517) but no keyboard grid navigation, no tabIndex; cells are clickable divs. Certification focusableElementCount=3 (skip links only). ARIA grid semantics without the required interaction model is worse than none.
api: forwardRef with manual ref merge (L374-381). onLayoutChange is invoked inside useMemo during render (L269-277) — a side effect in render that fires on every recompute and can loop if the parent sets state. Fixed containerWidth/Height defaults (800x600) for a 'responsive' grid; items assigned to sections purely by area order, ignoring aspectRatio/minSize/maxSize props that are declared (L26-28) but unused.
ssr: 'use client'; ResizeObserver only in effect. OK.
fake_complexity: Golden-ratio BSP subdivision is real but trivially simple; declared aspectRatio/minSize/maxSize constraints are never honored (assignItemsToSections L247-267). The spiral is decorative and not related to the section geometry.
justification: A gimmick layout with a debug HUD ('Sections/Items/Golden Ratio/Levels' L561-576), fake ARIA grid semantics, render-phase side effects, and unused sizing props. Real apps use CSS grid; a premium design system does not ship a 'golden ratio' grid with a dashed gold spiral overlay. Remove.

name: GlassIslandLayout
material_impl: OptimizedGlass variant='frosted' root and per-island (L689, L824). Controls/stats bypass the primitive with inline rgba(255,255,255,.2) backgrounds, rgba(148,163,184,.3) borders and radius 14 repeated 4x (L593-596, L617-625, L637-645, L653-660, L673-681). Tailwind non-prefixed classes mixed with glass-* (bg-blue-400, ring-blue-400, border-yellow-400/50). Dynamic class 'duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]' (L803, L826) cannot be generated by any static CSS build.
motion: framer-motion entrance; reduced motion half-wired: initial uses shouldAnimate but animate uses prefersReducedMotion ? {} (L815-821), so reduced-motion users can be left at initial state if hooks disagree. 'Physics' rAF loop: updatePhysics depends on physicsIslands (L273), so the effect tears down and restarts every frame (L276-291); physics never sets a boundary on right/bottom.
a11y: Zoom/connect/arrange controls are emoji-only buttons (🔍+, 🔍-, 🔗, ⚡) with no aria-label (L612-684). Minimize button has tabIndex=-1 (L850) — unreachable by keyboard. Dragging is mouse-only via document mousemove (L533-541); no touch/pointer or keyboard move. Connection canvas sets strokeStyle to 'var(--glass-bg-hover)' (L324, L349) — canvas does not resolve CSS variables, so the assignment is ignored and lines render in default black.
api: forwardRef. No style passthrough. config captured once in useState (L153-156) so later config changes are ignored. enableResizing renders a handle that sets isResizing but no resize logic exists; onIslandResize is never called (L870-881, L76). Header text 'Island Layout / Floating content islands with connections' is hard-coded (L736-741). Inner components Minimap/StatsPanel/Controls defined inside render remount every render (L543-686).
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners in effect only. Fixed 2000x2000 world canvas (L766-797) allocates a 16MB backing store regardless of content.
fake_complexity: 'Physics' is a naive O(n^2) repulsion loop with no right/bottom bounds; 'resizable' is a no-op; 'Auto-arrange' uses fixed +400 offsets. Story content is fake KPI cards ('Users: 1,234 Revenue: $5,678' per certification text sample).
justification: A half-built node-graph editor: resizing is a stub, connection colors silently fail on canvas, physics re-subscribes rAF every frame, controls are unlabeled emoji, and the minimize control is keyboard-unreachable. Not salvageable as a design-system primitive; a real canvas/graph editor is application territory (React Flow etc.). Deprecate in 5.0, remove in 6.0.

name: GlassMasonryGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass frosted root and one OptimizedGlass per item (L578, L694) — nested backdrop-filter on every tile (177 glass elements in certification DOM count). Root force-overrides text tokens with hard-coded dark slate rgba(15,23,42,.94/.76/.64) (L587-589), breaking dark themes. StatsPanel puts createGlassStyle(...).background (a CSS value) into className (L532-535) — a bug, yields a garbage class.
motion: framer-motion staggered entrance; reduced motion wired via both useReducedMotion and shouldAnimate (L668-679). Skeleton heights use Math.random() in render (L722) — they jitter on every render and mismatch SSR.
a11y: Items are clickable motion.divs with no role/tabIndex/keyboard (L650-693). Sort-order button is a bare arrow glyph with no aria-label (L507-517). Search input has no label (L452-458). FilterControls is a component declared inside render (L448) and rendered as <FilterControls/> (L630), so it remounts on every state change — the search input loses focus after each keystroke.
api: forwardRef but no style passthrough. config frozen in useState (L140-143). Props filterBy/sortBy only seed state; not controlled. enableDragReorder: onDragEnd calls handleDrop(event, item.id) with the dragged item's own id (L685-688), so dragged===target and reorder is a no-op. enableVirtualization never listens to scroll (updateLayout only on resize), so 'visible' set is computed once. Infinite-scroll sentinel is appended to the DOM each time loadingMore toggles and never removed (L390-399). Header copy 'Masonry Grid / Pinterest-style dynamic layout system' hard-coded (L607-612).
ssr: 'use client'; window resize + ResizeObserver in effects. Math.random in render (L722) causes hydration mismatch when loadingItems>0.
fake_complexity: Advertised drag-reorder, virtualization and infinite scroll are effectively non-functional (see api). Item heights are prop-driven, not measured, so real content clips/scrolls inside tiles (overflow:auto L700).
justification: Masonry is a legitimate need, but this implementation is a demo panel (hard-coded header, stats HUD, footer 'Grid: WxH px') wrapped around broken features: search loses focus each keystroke, drag-reorder is a no-op, virtualization ignores scroll, sentinel leaks. The 107-line GlassMasonry already exists. Consolidate into one headless masonry (CSS columns or measured layout) with optional toolbar composition; drop the stats/filters baked into the layout.

name: GlassOrbitalMenu
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root with hard-coded blur 20/opacity .8/saturation 1.2 (L223-229) — the whole square bounding box is a glass slab, not just the buttons. Items are bespoke 'glass-surface rounded-full border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 text-white/90' (L297-306): hard-coded white text that fails on light themes.
motion: framer-motion variants with invalid tension/friction keys (L173-176, L183-186, L207-209, L366-370). autoRotate effect lists `rotation` in deps (L109-116) so the rAF loop is torn down and recreated every frame, and setRotation every frame re-renders the whole menu at 60fps; rotationValue/rotationTransform are computed but unused (L92-93). Reduced motion: disables stagger/rotation, but also hides the hover label entirely (L335) — reduced-motion users lose the only visible text label.
a11y: Center button has aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-label (L249-251) — good. role='toolbar' (L231) without arrow-key roving focus; items redundantly set role='button' on <button>. No Escape-to-close, no focus return. Labels shown only on mouse hover (L335-345), never on focus.
api: forwardRef, className/style. Controlled-only isOpen (no defaultOpen); onOpenChange required to function. springTension/springFriction props are react-spring vocabulary and do nothing in framer-motion. Status text '{n} items' rendered in corner (L377-379).
fake_complexity: None major; it's a straightforward radial menu, but advertised spring tuning is non-functional.
justification: A radial menu is a plausible signature interaction for a Liquid Glass system, and the open/close semantics are partially right, but it needs a rebuild: per-item Liquid material instead of a glass box, roving tabindex + arrow keys + Escape, labels on focus, real framer spring params (stiffness/damping), and no 60fps setState rotation. Fold into a GlassFab 'radial' variant rather than a standalone 'layout'.

name: GlassTessellation
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root (L568-598); tiles are flat SVG paths with hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,.22/.34) fill and rgba(248,250,252,.36/.72) stroke (L448-456) — no glass material on tiles at all (SVG can't backdrop-filter). Has a real luminance-based readable-text helper (L77-125), the one good idea here. Grid pattern uses a global id='grid' (L625) that collides with any other SVG on the page.
motion: framer-motion rotate -180 -> 0 entrance per tile with invalid tension/friction keys (L532-565). Reduced motion only zeroes stagger delay (L546); spin-in still plays. morphPattern rAF setState loop guarded by reduced motion (L184-201).
a11y: role='application' (L599); tiles are motion.g with onClick/hover only — not focusable (certification focusableElementCount=3, skip links only). Content in foreignObject. No accessible names for tiles.
api: forwardRef, className/style. 'hexagonal' places hexes on a grid of size*sqrt(3) while drawing hexagons of width=size (L269-284 vs L469-477) so tiles don't actually tessellate; 'pentagonal' is admitted approximation with rotation (row*col*72) (L330-359). Fixed containerWidth 800 default. setTimeout without cleanup on click (L424).
fake_complexity: 'Tessellation' patterns do not tessellate (gap/overlap math mismatch); 'mixed' is sin-wobble scatter. Novelty with mathematical branding.
justification: No glass material on the tiles, no keyboard access, misconfigured motion, and the geometry doesn't actually tessellate. Pure novelty. Remove; salvage getReadableTextColor (L113-125) into the shared contrast utilities if not already duplicated there.

name: AuroraBackground
material_impl: Pure CSS in marketing.css with token fallbacks: --ag-aurora-a..d resolve from --aura-marketing-palettes-* then --glass-color-* (marketing.css:1-96), palettes via [data-ag-palette] (marketing.css:888-947). Blobs are conic gradients blurred 54px (marketing.css:452-462), SVG feTurbulence grain (L504-508), radial vignette. No JS glass primitive needed — appropriate for a backdrop.
motion: CSS keyframes (ag-aurora-drift, ag-particle-float). Reduced motion wired three ways: reducedMotion prop -> data-motion='none' (AuroraBackground.tsx:102,111), data-ag-reduced-motion kill switch (marketing.css:949-954), and @media (prefers-reduced-motion) for the whole scope (marketing.css:956-963). Correct.
a11y: aria-hidden defaults true when no children (L107-109); pointer-events none. Forced-colors handled in shared CSS. Good.
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, cn. Deterministic seeded particles (FNV hash + LCG, L33-66) — SSR-stable, no hydration mismatch. data-attribute driven variants. Naming prefix 'ag-' differs from the rest of the library's 'glass-' utilities.
ssr: 'use client' though it has no client-only behavior (could be a server component). Side-effect CSS import './marketing.css' (L6) requires consumer bundler CSS support; Next pages-router disallows global CSS imports from node_modules in some configs.
justification: The cleanest backdrop in the shard: tokenized, deterministic, SSR-safe, and the only component here with genuinely correct reduced-motion and forced-colors handling. It should become THE canonical atmospheric backdrop and absorb GlassAuroraDisplay/AuroraPro (DEPRECATE those). Polish: drop 'use client', reconcile 'ag-' vs 'glass-' naming, add more stories (palettes x intensity x light/dark), and get it into the visual certification set (no screenshot slug exists).

name: AuroraOrb
material_impl: CSS conic-gradient core + radial shine + drop-shadow glow from palette tokens (marketing.css:519-579). Not glass — a gradient sphere. Tokens used throughout.
motion: CSS pulse keyframe (marketing.css:576-579, 997-1005); pointer tilt via CSS variables set imperatively (L39-61) — no rerender, cheap. Covered by the shared prefers-reduced-motion kill (marketing.css:956-963), but pointer tilt still applies under reduced motion (it's direct manipulation, acceptable).
a11y: aria-hidden defaults to true even when children are passed (L77) — children content would be hidden from AT.
api: forwardRef, style merge, consumer onPointerMove/Leave are chained (L45, L60, L71). Clean.
ssr: 'use client' needed for pointer handlers; CSS side-effect import.
justification: Small, correct, cheap. It's a gradient sphere, not glass, so it's decoration for marketing pages only. Fix aria-hidden-with-children, keep in the ./marketing subpath, and avoid promoting it as a material showcase.

name: DisplayText
material_impl: N/A (typography). Gradient text via background-clip from palette tokens (marketing.css:626-637); forced-colors fallback (L965-969).
a11y: Semantic element via `as` (h1/h2/h3/p/span) decoupled from visual size — correct. Gradient text contrast not guaranteed on arbitrary palettes; forced-colors handled.
api: forwardRef, polymorphic `as` (limited union), size hero/section/title/label, balance. Default font stack is a generic 'ui-serif, Georgia, Times' fallback (marketing.css:584-592) unless --ag-marketing-display-font is set — out of the box it renders Georgia, not a branded display face. letter-spacing 0 on hero sizes (L594) — premium display type normally tightens tracking.
duplicates: any Glass typography/heading components in the library (not in this shard)
justification: Correct and tiny, but typographically generic: default Georgia fallback and zero tracking make hero text look like a blog, not a first-party system. Ship a real display type scale (font, optical tracking per size) in tokens, drop 'use client', and align with the main typography components so there aren't two heading systems.

name: FeatureTile
material_impl: Composes ShowcaseCard (shared marketing material) — good reuse. Index badge uses aurora gradient with white text (marketing.css:776-786).
a11y: Title hard-coded as <h3> (L57) regardless of document outline. White index text on light aurora gradients may fail contrast.
api: forwardRef, passthrough. tone 'success'/'info'/'warning' all map to the same 'subtle' glow (L18-27) — tone prop is mostly cosmetic data-attr with no CSS for data-tone, so success/info/warning render identically to neutral.
fake_complexity: tone variants are non-functional (no [data-tone] CSS rules in marketing.css).
justification: Good compositional pattern, but tone variants are fake (no CSS for data-tone) and the heading level is fixed. Add headingLevel/as, implement or remove tones, verify index-badge contrast.

name: InstallCommand
material_impl: Reuses .ag-showcase-card classes directly by string (L60) rather than composing ShowcaseCard; subtle glass bg tokens.
motion: CSS color transitions, covered by reduced-motion kill.
a11y: Real <button type=button>, aria-label, visually-hidden role=status aria-live (L80-86) — good. Focus-visible outline tokenized (marketing.css:868-872).
api: forwardRef. Default commands hard-code the package name 'aura-glass' (L19-22) — this is docs-site chrome for AuraGlass itself, not a reusable component. 'Copied' state never resets (L53) and clipboard rejection is unhandled (await without try, L52) -> unhandled promise rejection in insecure contexts.
duplicates: any GlassCodeBlock/copy button in the library (not in shard)
justification: Accessible and small, but it's AuraGlass-docs chrome shipped as a library component. Generalize into a CopyableCode/Snippet (package name not baked in), reset copied state after timeout, catch clipboard errors, and compose ShowcaseCard instead of borrowing its class string.

name: LogoMark
material_impl: Conic aurora core + inner rounded square (marketing.css:647-664); launch-kit overrides add real backdrop-filter glass (L284-309).
a11y: role=img + aria-label when label given, otherwise aria-hidden (L34-36). Correct.
justification: It is the AuraGlass brand glyph rendered generically (rounded square of gradient). Fine for the docs/marketing subpath; does not belong in the root barrel. Move to ./marketing only and keep as brand asset.

name: ShowcaseCard
material_impl: Tokenized CSS glass: blur(var(--glass-marketing-glass-blur)) saturate(1.65) + --glass-filter-base, border/bg/shadow/highlight all from tokens with --aura-* overrides (marketing.css:666-678, 713-763). Specular top highlight ::before. This is a cleaner material than most JS-built glass in this shard, but is a parallel material system to OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial.
motion: Optional CSS float + hover lift, reduced-motion covered.
a11y: interactive=true adds hover lift and a :focus-visible style but no tabIndex/role — 'interactive' card isn't actually focusable unless consumer adds it.
justification: Good, token-driven CSS card — but it is a second card material system alongside GlassCard/OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial. Fold its data-attribute + CSS-variable approach into GlassCard as the canonical implementation (or make ShowcaseCard a GlassCard preset) so there is one card material in 5.0.

name: GlassAdvancedAudioPlayer
material_impl: Glass primitive root but style overridden with createGlassStyle from core/mixins/glassMixins (a different createGlassStyle than utils/createGlassStyle used elsewhere) plus inline rgba borders/shadows (L1096-1105). Button styles hard-code rgba gradients and shadows (L70-102). Playlist/transcript rows use opaque light rgba(255,255,255,.74)/rgba(219,234,254,.9) backgrounds (L513-516, L629-631) — not glass, breaks dark mode. 180 lines of CSS injected via <style> per instance (L111-183, L1107). Canvas colors set to 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))'/'var(--glass-gray-200)' (L238-239, L363, L397) — canvas cannot resolve CSS vars, so these are silently ignored. Bars visualizer uses rainbow rgb() (L345-349). Emoji transport icons ⏪⏸️▶️⏩🔇🔊 (L913, L1024-1058).
motion: Canvas rAF for visualizer only. No reduced-motion handling for visualizer animation.
a11y: Buttons have aria-labels (good). Progress bar is a clickable div with no role=slider/keyboard (L998-1013); waveform canvas seek is mouse-only (L290-299). Transcript search input unlabeled (L603-609). Emoji icons render inconsistently across OSes.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style/rest passthrough. showLyrics declared, never used (L18, L673). handleMediaSelect only calls provider play(media.id) — the <audio src> is bound to the mediaFile prop, so selecting a playlist track does not change what plays (L874-880, L1113). Search highlight builds RegExp from raw user input (L577) — typing '(' or '[' throws and crashes the panel. Player state depends on provider play(), which no-ops unless the file was registered via addMediaFile (GlassMediaProvider.tsx:407-431); the story does not register (GlassAdvancedAudioPlayer.stories.tsx:69-80), so isPlaying stays false and every click re-calls audio.play() — the button can never pause.
ssr: 'use client'; AudioContext created lazily on gesture (L729-749). OK. createMediaElementSource on cross-origin audio without CORS mutes output.
fake_complexity: 'Waveform' is mock sine data, not decoded audio (L774-786, comment 'Generate mock waveform data'). Transcript comes from the provider's mock transcription service (fake speakers, Math.random confidence). Story fixture src is 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,' (empty) with visualizer/waveform/transcript/playlist all disabled (stories L43, L72-76) — the certified screenshot shows a static shell with none of the 'advanced' features.
justification: Feature list is fiction: mock waveform, mock transcripts, playlist that doesn't change tracks, play/pause that can't pause without hidden provider registration, a RegExp crash on search, emoji icons, canvas colors that silently fail. Rebuild as a composition: headless media hook bound to the <audio> element as source of truth, LiquidGlassMediaControls for transport, icon set instead of emoji, real slider semantics, optional transcript slot fed by consumer data.

name: GlassAdvancedVideoPlayer
material_impl: Root is a plain div with inline bespoke glass: linear-gradient rgba whites, blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04) hard-coded (L1167-1175) — bypasses Glass/LiquidGlass primitives. Controls bar adds a second backdrop-filter level4 (L209-218, L462). Active menu items use hard-coded blue rgba(37,99,235,.96) + #f8fafc (L620-627, L664-673, L719-725). 260 lines of CSS injected per instance with many !important (L151-411). Emoji icons 🔇🔉🔊 ⊟⊞ ⚠️ and sentiment 😊😔😐 (L549, L689, L1243, L880-884).
motion: No motion system; controls auto-hide via setTimeout (L1028-1042) stored in state (re-render per mousemove). No reduced-motion concerns beyond spinner.
a11y: Buttons labeled. Progress bar is a div with click/drag mouse-only, no role=slider/aria-valuenow/keyboard (L473-507). Volume slider appears on hover only (L536-568) and has no aria-label. Speed/quality popovers have no menu semantics, no Escape, no outside-click close. Controls overlay is removed on mouseleave even when paused (L1183) — keyboard users tabbing in can find controls unmounted. No keyboard shortcuts (space/arrow/f/m). Captions/subtitles never rendered as <track> despite MediaSubtitle data.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style passthrough. showAnalytics declared, unused (L20, L923). Quality menu only sets provider state; video source never changes (L1276, GlassMediaProvider.tsx:487-489) — 'quality' is cosmetic. buffered read from videoRef during render (L1265-1271). isStorybookDataMedia (L82-83, L985-986) swaps data: video sources for a poster — Storybook-specific logic in production code; the certified screenshot is of a static poster image, not a video. Same provider registration dependency as the audio player (play() no-ops unless addMediaFile was called).
ssr: 'use client'; document.exitFullscreen only in handler. OK.
fake_complexity: Quality selection fake; transcript keywords/sentiment/confidence come from mock service with Math.random (GlassMediaProvider.tsx:277-286); analytics flag unused; storybook poster hack hides the actual video path from visual QA.
target: single GlassVideoPlayer (merge with src/components/interactive/GlassVideoPlayer.tsx) built on LiquidGlassMediaControls
justification: Two video players exist; this one has fake quality switching, no keyboard model, hover-only volume, no captions, emoji iconography, hard-coded blue selection, and a Storybook-only poster swap that means the certification never saw a video. A media player is a strong flagship opportunity for Liquid Glass (floating controls over content is exactly the material's use case), but it must be rebuilt: element-as-source-of-truth state, slider semantics, keyboard shortcuts, <track> captions, LiquidGlassMaterial controls with local dimming.

name: GlassMediaProvider
material_impl: Non-visual provider; renders a wrapper <div> (L783) — the story builds its own visual card ('Live media context / Media workspace ready' per certification text) which is what got certified.
api: Exported as both MediaProvider and GlassMediaProvider (L790; media/index.ts exports MediaProvider, root exports GlassMediaProvider). 35-member context value rebuilt every render, not memoized (L741-779) — every consumer re-renders on every timeupdate. Duplicated state: playbackState mirrors the media element and is fed by setPlaybackState({...playbackState}) from players using stale closures. play() silently no-ops if the file wasn't addMediaFile'd (L407-431). play/pause/seek reference trackEngagement before declaration and omit it from deps (L427, L430). useMedia() falls back to a no-op default context (L192-230, L792-795), so forgetting the provider produces dead players with no warning. Passes a stray data-glass-component prop to Context.Provider (L782). startRecording never stops stream tracks (camera/mic LED stays on) and ignores RecordingOptions (L672-699); stopRecording hard-codes type video/webm even for audio (L706-717); object URLs never revoked.
ssr: 'use client'; navigator guarded in effect. OK.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'AI Features' are a mockTranscriptionService (L239-306): setTimeout(2000) then canned sentences about 'advanced media components', fabricated speakers ('Alice Johnson', 'Bob Smith', 'Dr. Sarah Chen'), confidence = 0.85+Math.random()*0.15, random keywords and random sentiment (L249-286). generateSummary returns a hard-coded paragraph (L292-296). analyzeSentiment/extractKeywords just read back the random values. This ships in production bundles and the players call it automatically when showTranscript is on.
duplicates: any media state hook; GlassImageProcessingProvider follows same mock-AI pattern (src/index.ts:716)
target: headless useMediaElement(ref) hook + optional lightweight MediaSession context; no built-in AI
justification: Ships fake AI (canned transcripts with invented speaker names and random confidence/sentiment) in a production library — a credibility liability. Architecturally it duplicates the media element's state, requires undocumented registration for play() to work, re-renders all consumers on every time update, and leaks recording streams. Replace with a headless hook where the HTMLMediaElement is the single source of truth; transcripts/chapters become consumer-supplied data; recording moves out of the design system.

name: LiquidGlassMediaControls
material_impl: Shared primitive LiquidGlassMaterial material='liquid' variant clear/regular, radius full, data-local-dimming (L84-93) — the right foundation. Button uses createGlassStyle (core/mixins) + hard-coded light gradient rgba(255,255,255,.34)->rgba(248,250,252,.24) (L22-30); ranges hard-code accentColor #64748b and slate rgba shadows (L32-45). tintMode='light' fixed (L88) — no dark/adaptive option exposed.
a11y: Native <button> and <input type=range> with aria-labels (L102-138) — keyboard works by default. Play button shows the words 'Play'/'Pause' (L108) instead of icons (functional but not premium); aria-label duplicates text. Seek range has no step and no aria-valuetext (screen readers announce raw seconds).
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, controlled (playing/currentTime/volume + callbacks), variant/compact. Aliased in root as GlassMediaControls too (src/index.ts:721-726) — two names for one component.
justification: The only honest media component in the shard: controlled, native semantics, built on LiquidGlassMaterial. It should become the canonical transport bar that both advanced players compose. Needs: real icon glyphs, tokenized range track/thumb styling (no #64748b), aria-valuetext with formatted time, skip/next slots, adaptive tint, and real visual certification (no screenshot slug exists). With that work, 'floating Liquid Glass controls over video' is a credible flagship screenshot.
